notes: First-person story turned into a scene; dialogue kept as written, only 'fucking' softened in text. The mother wears stubble and a dark suit so the guest's mistake is visible; the bride stands in white with the guests behind.
title: The Bride's Father

lines.text: At a wedding, a man whispers to the guy next to him.
Isn't the bride a right ugly dog?
Do you mind. That's my daughter you're talking about.
I'm sorry, I didn't know you were her father...
I'm not... I'm her freaking mother.
lines.uncensored: I'm not... I'm her fucking mother.

notes: Line-by-line translation; the mother's lines before the punchline have no gendered verb forms. 'Блядь' softened to 'блин' in text.
title: Отец невесты

lines.text: На свадьбе мужик шепчет соседу.
Правда, невеста страшная, как собака?
Попрошу! Это вы о моей дочери говорите.
Простите, я не знал, что вы её отец...
Я не отец... Я её, блин, мать!
lines.uncensored: Я не отец... Я её, блядь, мать!

notes: Line-by-line translation; 'verdammte' stays, so no uncensored version is needed.
title: Der Brautvater

lines.text: Auf einer Hochzeit flüstert ein Mann seinem Nebenmann zu.
Ist die Braut nicht ein richtig hässlicher Hund?
Ich muss doch sehr bitten. Sie reden von meiner Tochter.
Verzeihung, ich wusste nicht, dass Sie ihr Vater sind...
Bin ich nicht... Ich bin ihre verdammte Mutter.

notes: All dialogue kept as written; the boy walks in from school. Only 'fuck' softened to 'heck' in text. The boy is unnamed in the source, so no name is used.
title: Bad Math Grade

lines.text: I got an F in math today.
What happened?
Well, my teacher asked me, what's three times two, and I said six.
Well, that's correct.
I know. Then she asked me, what's two times three.
What the heck is the difference?
lines.uncensored: What the fuck is the difference?

lines.text: That's what I said!

notes: F localised to двойка; line-by-line translation. 'На хрена' softened to 'на фига' in text.
title: Двойка по математике

lines.text: Пап, я сегодня двойку по математике получил.
Что случилось?
Ну, учительница спросила, сколько будет трижды два, и я сказал: шесть.
Ну, правильно.
Я знаю. А потом она спросила, сколько будет дважды три.
А какая, на фига, разница?
Вот и я так сказал!

notes: F localised to Sechs; line-by-line translation. 'Verdammte' stays, so no uncensored version.
title: Die Sechs in Mathe

lines.text: Ich hab heute eine Sechs in Mathe bekommen.
Was ist passiert?
Na ja, die Lehrerin hat mich gefragt, was ist drei mal zwei, und ich hab gesagt, sechs.
Na, das ist doch richtig.
Ich weiß. Dann hat sie gefragt, was ist zwei mal drei.
Was ist denn da der verdammte Unterschied?
Genau das hab ich auch gesagt!

notes: Dialogue kept as written; he leaves after her request and walks back in. Only 'fuck' softened to 'heck' in text. Glasses mark the programmer.
title: Milk and Eggs

lines.text: A wife asks her programmer husband to go to the store.
Can you go down to the store, and get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get six.
Later on he returns home.
Why the heck do you have six gallons of milk?
lines.uncensored: Why the fuck do you have six gallons of milk?

lines.text: They had eggs.

notes: Gallon localised to a litre; the six-eggs logic is unchanged. 'Нахуя' softened to 'нафига' in text.
title: Молоко и яйца

lines.text: Жена просит мужа-программиста сходить в магазин.
Сходи в магазин, купи литр молока, а если будут яйца, возьми шесть.
Через какое-то время он возвращается домой.
Нафига тебе шесть литров молока?
Яйца были.

notes: Gallon localised to a litre; line-by-line otherwise. 'Zum Teufel' carries the swear, so no uncensored version.
title: Milch und Eier

lines.text: Eine Frau bittet ihren Mann, einen Programmierer, einkaufen zu gehen.
Kannst du runter zum Laden gehen und einen Liter Milch holen, und wenn sie Eier haben, nimm sechs.
Später kommt er nach Hause.
Warum zum Teufel hast du sechs Liter Milch?
Sie hatten Eier.

notes: First-person story staged with all three people: the narrator sets the walk, the stranger's words and the girlfriend's demand become direct lines, the punchline is kept as written. Stubble marks the scruffy stranger.
title: Squats

lines.text: A young man is walking with his girlfriend when a random guy whistles at her.
Nice ass.
Say something!
Thank you, I've been doing squats.

notes: Line-by-line translation; 'задница' is mild enough to keep in the clean text.
title: Приседания

lines.text: Парень гуляет со своей девушкой, и вдруг какой-то тип свистит ей вслед.
Классная задница!
Скажи ему что-нибудь!
Спасибо, я приседаю.

notes: Line-by-line translation; 'Hintern' keeps the clean text without softening.
title: Kniebeugen

lines.text: Ein junger Mann geht mit seiner Freundin spazieren, als ein wildfremder Typ ihr hinterherpfeift.
Schöner Hintern.
Sag doch was!
Danke, ich mache viele Kniebeugen.

notes: Both lines kept as written. Cross-cut phone call: the young son in a doctor's coat at the hospital, his mother at home. Paren plays the doctor because the son is young; the source name Peter is kept.

lines.text: Mom? Don't freak out, but I'm in the hospital...
